node.label: Congenital hydrocele
node.definition: Congenital hydrocele occurs when processus vaginalis is patent and communicates with the peritoneal cavity. This communication allows the movement of peritoneal fluid but is too small to allow the intra-abdominal contents to herniate through.

evidence.snippet: Autoinflammatory disease, systemic, with vasculitis: Congenital hydrocele (frequency 1/1) [PCS]
